newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian government wins second confidence vote.
newsitem.headline: Italian government wins second confidence vote.

text.p: The Italian government won a second confidence vote in the Senate (upper house) on Wednesday to convert into law a decree covering a development project in Naples.
The motion brought by Prime Minister Romano Prodi's centre-left coalition government was carried with 167 votes in favour and 71 against with no abstentions.
Earlier on Wednesday the government won a confidence vote over a decree pushing through a rescue plan for ailing southern bank Banco di Napoli.
A third confidence vote, converting into law a decree on socially useful labour, is expected to go through later on Wednesday evening.
